BiblicalUsage: The nethermost chamber was five cubits broad, the middle six, and the third seven, for in the wall of the house he made narrowed rests round about, so the beams would not be fastened in the walls. The word is the ledge itself, the offset in the wall, and it is named once, in the building of the temple.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the narrowed rests show how carefully God builds: the beams rest on ledges, not in the walls, and the house stands because every part bears its own weight.
